description: This file defines a static class containing constants for JavaScript interop operations used in a Blazor project.

classes.name: JSInteropConstants
classes.description: A static class providing string constants for JavaScript interop calls such as cookie management and UI behavior toggles.

methods.name: DeleteCookie
methods.description: Represents the JavaScript function name for deleting a cookie.

methods.name: GetCookie
methods.description: Represents the JavaScript function name for retrieving a cookie.

methods.name: RouteOutside
methods.description: Represents the JavaScript function name for handling outside routing.

methods.name: HideBodyOverflow
methods.description: Represents the JavaScript function name for hiding body overflow.

methods.name: ShowBodyOverflow
methods.description: Represents the JavaScript function name for showing body overflow.
